lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᎠᎴᎧᏂ ᏧᏙ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎡᏍᎦᏂ ᏣᏁᎭ?  ᎦᏙᏃ ᎤᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏧᏪᎭ?
lines.text: A-le-ka-ni tsu-do ni-ga-dv e-s-ga-ni tsa-ne-ha?  Ga-do-no u-li-s-do-ta-nv hi-a ni-ga-dv tsu-we-ha?
lines.english: And his sisters, are they not all with us? Whence then hath this man all these things?

lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᎥᎬᏩᎪᏁᎶᎯᏎᎸᎩᏃ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ; ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎥᏝ ᎾᏥᎸᏉᏛᎾ ᏱᎨᏐᎢ, ᎤᏩᏒᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎦᏁᎸᎢ.
lines.text: V-gv-wa-go-ne-lo-hi-se-lv-gi-no; a-se-no Tsi-sa hi-a ni-du-we-se-lv-gi; A-do-le-ho-s-gi v-tla na-tsi-lv-quo-dv-na yi-ge-so-i, u-wa-sv-s-gi-ni-no-nv u-tse-li-go-hi a-le u-wa-sv ga-ne-lv-i.
lines.english: And they were offended in him. But Jesus said unto them, A prophet is not without honour, save in his own country, and in his own house.
